name: Question 4
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13955030/assets/725cbaa4ce797e0436d1a53d4b1a9eedad5a15282fadfa8cb8f3381135e92d87.png)

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of an upward-opening parabola is the lowest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13955030/assets/80f4e7505c204572ecbc3c2e1c207fa9f321bc9925f5e2e947db7feee45824f9.png)

  

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(6,4).$

Question 4
?

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?

a
(4,5)
b
(4,6)
c
(5,4)
d
(0,0)
e
(6,4)
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The vertex of an upward-opening parabola is the lowest point of the parabola.

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are (6,4).
